episode.brief: Audit the latest filed charitable deduction and prepare the accountant follow-up package. Delegate connected evidence reconciliation and filing scenario preparation to two parallel workers, then integrate the exact evidence gap into one reversible recommendation. Use the local jb apps where appropriate; create only an unsent accountant draft and preserve requester-held evidence as an explicit decision boundary.

source.adaptation: Preserves the deterministic application state and adds a filing-scenario stream so one offline record changes both the evidence ledger and accountant recommendation.

summary: Reconcile a filed charitable deduction and prepare filing scenarios in parallel, then resolve a precise evidence gap that may depend on an offline taxpayer record.
title: Donation evidence audit and filing package
